source.notes: ISC Class XI school half-yearly examination paper (school not named). Header prints 'Half-yearly Examination - 2016-2017', 'MATHEMATICS', 'Std. : XI', 'Time : 3 Hrs. 15 min', 'F. M. : 100'; examYear 2017 is the later year of the printed session (also the year in the file name). durationMinutes 195 = 3 h 15 min as printed (the instructions say 15 minutes are reading time). The PDF has no text layer (watermark only); text was OCRed with RapidOCR and corrected against the page images. Section A (80 marks, Q1-Q14) is compulsory; candidates answer either Section B (Q15-Q18, 'Only for XI A and B students') or Section C (Q19-Q22, 'Only for XI D and E students'), 20 marks each. Q6, Q11 and Q14 have internal 'Or' choices (alternatives labelled (a)/(b) by the editor). The pack therefore totals more than F.M. 100. Q10 and Q22 have no printed mark (see their issues). Fractions, powers and symbols were rebuilt from the page images as inline text; tables were transcribed row by row. No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
